title: Budget — Zero-based (catch-all)
description: Top-down budgeting: a total budget on a node, explicit budgets for some children, and everything else collapsed into a single 'Unbudgeted' bucket. Demoed on Expenses:Insurance (total 500, named child Health 450, remainder = Dental + Vision). Beancount can't budget the bare Expenses root, so the total is scoped to a real subtree.

widgets.title: Insurance — named carve-outs + Unbudgeted
widgets.helpText: Named lines are inclusive; 'Unbudgeted' is the leftover (total budget − named budgets). Σ(named) + Unbudgeted = Total.

steps.query: SELECT account, currency, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS actual FROM postings WHERE account LIKE 'Expenses:Insurance%' AND transaction_date BETWEEN :monthStart AND :monthEnd AND currency = :currency GROUP BY account, currency
